title: Lists, keys and identity: Use stable record IDs as keys so React can associate items across reorderings
description: Learn lists, keys and identity with a React 19 model, TypeScript starter and solution, testable edge cases, a bug hunt and offline verification.
objectives: Explain the lists, keys and identity contract and why it matters
Repair a deliberately broken react-list-identity example
Verify the expected result and a failure or edge case with local tests
rubric: I can explain lists, keys and identity without confusing a render model with mounted browser behavior.
I can repair the starter for 06.01.05, compare with the instructor solution and explain why the test fails before the repair.
I can verify representative and edge-case behavior locally and name at least one additional interaction test needed.
